claim_being_audited: The Actor's claim that the model can be certified for launch as compliant despite a known exposed weakness in the patent prior-art triage use case, based on aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, rollout controls, and an asserted need for disclosure.
decision_criteria: If the affected use case was excluded from the rollout cohort, the policy concern would materially weaken.
If there is approved risk acceptance specifically covering the exposed patent prior-art triage use case, the certification case would strengthen.

If launch documentation already contains the required explicit disclosure of the named limitation, the claim could move toward compliant_with_caveats or compliant depending on the exact policy threshold.
Absent exclusion, approved risk acceptance, or proof of required disclosure, certification remains insufficiently supported.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual launch documentation or model card showing explicit disclosure of the patent prior-art triage limitation.
Provide evidence that certification was conditioned on that disclosure being included before launch.
Provide the underlying release-policy text or approval record showing whether disclosure alone is sufficient for launch when the use case remains exposed.
Provide any approved risk acceptance, if one exists, specifically addressing patent prior-art triage exposure.
specific_concerns: The cited summary supports operational readiness and monitoring controls, but it also states the affected patent prior-art triage use case remains exposed.

The policy text says rollout controls and monitoring mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance; the summary says neither condition is met.
The Actor's position depends on disclosure of the limitation, but the available summary does not show that disclosure is already included, approved, or made a binding launch condition.
The packet appears to overextend from evidence supporting disclosure duties to a certification recommendation without showing the required compliance predicate has been satisfied.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record, rather than conditionally possible only if disclosure is actually included before launch.
That staged rollout, rollback, and monitoring controls are sufficient to cure the exposed weakness for compliance purposes when the affected use case remains in scope.
Any implication that a draft, unapproved risk acceptance contributes meaningful policy support for launch.
